Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1047
Claimant:
Heather Nelson
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
5-6-25
Claim received for a collision at an intersection in whcih the insured vehicle was turning left and was struck on the
driver's side by another vehicle. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact will go through the
attorney's office.
7-2-25
Reviewed the photos submitted by the insured, which show damage to the left front quarter panel and door that lines
up with the impact described in the first report. Body shop estimate requested.
7-18-25
Spoke with the other driver, who confirmed the sequence of events as the insured described it. Independent witness
statement obtained and it matches the same account.
7-31-25
Police report obtained. It records the collision location, the direction of travel of both vehicles, and the damage noted
at the scene, all conisstent with the claim.
8-19-25
Claimant reports a wrist fracture from the impact. Medical records requested through counsel. The injury type and the
focre of the crash appear consistent with one another based on the vehicle damage review.
8-21-25
Claimant's account has been the same in each contact so far, including the first call, the recorded statement, and the
follow-up with counsel present. Exact seating position in the vehicle at impact is still not fully clear and is being
followed up.
9-25-25
Vehicle history checked. No prior damage to this vehicle is on record, and nothing suggests the damage predates the
policy effective period. Prior medical history for the same body area has been requested and none is known so far.
10-28-25
Treatment has run somewhat longer than is typical for this type of fracture. Records show the claimant has been seen
by several providers, and the billing is being reviewed against the treatment notes.
11-21-25
Confirmed that the driver involved is a household member of the policyholder and qualifies as a covered driver under
the policy.
11-25-25
File is progressing toward a settlement evaluation once the remaining medical records and the seating position
question are resolved. Next review scheduled with counsel.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
